title: Crispy Ethiopian Fish Tacos
description: A fusion dish combining the flavors of Ethiopia and Mexico, featuring crispy fish and crunchy slaw.

ingredients.name: Cucumber Slaw
ingredients.notes: Thinly sliced, with vinegar, chili flakes

instructions: 1. Prepare the Ethiopian spices by mixing berbere, niter kibbeh, and garlic.
2. Coat the fish fillets with the spice mixture, and sear in a pan at 375°F (190°C) for 3-4 minutes per side.
3. Meanwhile, warm the crispy tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
4. Assemble the tacos by placing a piece of fish on each tortilla, followed by a spoonful of cucumber slaw and a squeeze of lemon juice.
